## Overview

Often considered the core of local government, the Town Clerk's Office serves as the central information point for local residents and citizens at large. The Town Clerk is the keeper of town records, the chief election official, a member of the Board of Registrars, official keeper of the Town Seal, registers all vital events occurring within the community and those events occurring elsewhere to local residents. The Town Clerk records and preserves birth, marriage and death records and provides certified copies of these records upon request.

The Town Clerk also serves as the Chief Election Official and is directly responsible to the 
Voters of the Town.  The Town Clerk oversees the eight polling locations and the conduct of all 
elections and election related activity such as early voting in person and by mail.  The Clerk 
works with the Board of Registrars to promote and maintain voter registration and voter records.  
We prepare, record and report official election results to the Secretary of the Commonwealth.  
Our office prepares ballots, voting equipment, voting lists and certifies nomination papers as 
well as initiative petitions.  Our office records and certifies all official actions of Town, 
including Town Meeting legislation and appropriations, Planning and Zoning Board of Appeals 
Decisions, signs all notes for borrowing and is the keeper of the Town Seal. 
 
The Town Clerk can provide certified copies of all vital records we have on file as well as 
preserves original birth, marriage and death records.  Our office provides Justice of the Peace, 
Notary and Commissioner to Qualify services.  The office conducts the annual Town census and 
provides access to public records in compliance with the State Public Records Law and 
corresponding regulations. 
 
Elections 
 
April 8, 2025 the Annual Town Election was held and a total of 5,242 ballots were cast.
